rules.name: Ambush
rules.description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be deployed anywhere over 9” away from enemy units. Players alternate in placing Ambush units, starting with the player that activates next. Units that deploy via Ambush can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy.

rules.name: Anti-Cover
rules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

rules.name: AP
rules.description: AP

rules.name: Armor
rules.description: Counts as having Defense X+.

rules.name: Bounding
rules.description: When this unit is activated, you may move all models with this rule in it by up to D3+1".

rules.name: Counter
rules.description: May strike first with this weapon when charged, unless this unit is Fatigued.

rules.name: Counter in Melee
rules.description: This model gets Counter on its weapons in melee.

rules.name: Counter in Melee Buff
rules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 friendly units within 12", which gets Counter in Melee.

rules.name: Deadly
rules.description: Assign each wound to one model, and multiply it by X. Hits from Deadly must be resolved first, and these wounds don’t carry over to other models if the original target is killed.

rules.name: Defense
rules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

rules.name: Demolish
rules.description: Ignores Cover, and when attacking units with most models within 1" of terrain, this weapon gets AP(+1).

rules.name: Dodge
rules.description: If most models in this unit have this rule, as long as they aren't Fatigued, enemy units get -1 to hit rolls in melee against them.

rules.name: Enhanced Shadowborn
rules.description: If most models in this unit have Shadowborn, enemy units shooting/charging it get -8"/-4" range to a min. of 6" from Shadowborn (instead of only -4"/-2").

rules.name: Enhanced Shadowborn Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Enhanced Shadowborn. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Enhanced Shadowborn Buff
rules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 friendly units within 12", which gets Enhanced Shadowborn once (next time the effect would apply).

rules.name: Enhanced Shrouded
rules.description: If most models in this unit have Shrouded, enemy units shooting/charging it get -8"/-4" range to a min. of 6" from Shrouded (instead of only -4"/-2").

rules.name: Extended Buff Range
rules.description: If this unit is within 24" of another friendly unit with this rule that is within 6" of a friendly Hero, then that Hero may use special rules that allow it to pick friendly units within 12" (except for spells) on this unit as if it was in range.

rules.name: Hero
rules.description: Units within 6” of friendly Heroes may use the Hero’s Quality for Morale Tests as long as the Hero isn’t Shaken.

rules.name: Increased Shooting Range Buff
rules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 friendly units within 12", which gets +6" range on its weapons when shooting once (next time the effect would apply).

rules.name: Melee Slayer
rules.description: When charging, this model's weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(9) or higher.

rules.name: Precision Target
rules.description: Once per game, during this model's activation, before attacking, pick X enemy units within 18" and in line of sight of it, and place one token on them. Friendly units get +1 to hit rolls when attacking them.

rules.name: Rapid Rush
rules.description: This model moves +6" when using Rush actions.

rules.name: Rapid Rush Buff
rules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 friendly units within 12", which gets Rapid Rush once (next time the effect would apply).

rules.name: Ravage
rules.description: Once per round, when it’s this model’s turn to strike in melee, roll X dice before attacking, unless this unit is Fatigued. For each 6+ the target takes one wound.

rules.name: Regeneration
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

rules.name: Regeneration Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Regeneration. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Repel Ambushers
rules.description: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

rules.name: Shadowborn
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule is targeted by an enemy unit for shooting/charging, that enemy unit gets -4"/-2" range to a min. of 6".

rules.name: Shrouded
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule is targeted by an enemy unit for shooting/charging, that enemy unit gets -4"/-2" range to a min. of 6".

rules.name: Thrust
rules.description: When charging, gets +1 to hit rolls and AP(+1) in melee.

rules.name: Thrust in Melee
rules.description: This model gets Thrust on its weapons in melee.

rules.name: Thrust in Melee Buff
rules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 friendly units within 12", which gets Thrust in Melee once (next time the effect would apply).

rules.name: Tough
rules.description: Once a model has taken as many wounds as its Tough value, it is killed (remove from play).

rules.name: Unpredictable Fighter
rules.description: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1) on their weapons, and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

spells.name: Combat Psychosis
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Unpredictable Fighter against once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Cyber Shock
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 6", which takes 1 hit with AP(2) and Deadly(3).

spells.name: Optical Malfunction
spells.effect: Pick up to three friendly units within 18", which get Enhanced Shadowborn once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Overheat Internals
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which takes 4 hits with Demolish.

spells.name: Synaptic Stims
spells.effect: Pick up to two friendly units within 12", which moves +2" when using Advance actions and +4" when using Rush/Charge actions once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: System Collapse
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which takes 9 hits.
